# NorthKey AI

> A United States AI consulting firm covering the whole path from problem to
> outcome: consulting, solutions and development, an academy, assessments, and
> AI talent on contract. Concept stage — the site is a working build of a firm
> that is being stood up, not a record of delivered work.

Read this first: this site publishes what most AI consultancies withhold
(indicative pricing, the delivery method, a free maturity assessment) and
withholds what most of them assert (client names, analyst badges, partner
tiers, headcount and revenue figures). Anything not stated here is not claimed.

URLs below are relative because the production domain is not yet decided; every
absolute URL on this site still carries a literal `[DOMAIN]` placeholder by
design, and is resolved at runtime against whatever origin serves the page.

## What the firm does

- [AI Consulting](ai-consulting.html): strategy, architecture, governance, adoption and implementation oversight.
- [AI Solutions and Development](ai-solutions.html): generative AI, RAG, integration and production delivery.
- [AI Agents](ai-agents.html): agent design, tool use, evaluation and operational control.
- [AI Training and Academy](ai-training.html): curriculum organised by domain and by role.
- [AI Assessments](ai-assessments.html): scored competency across eight domains.
- [AI Talent and Contract Services](ai-talent.html): assessed profiles rather than résumés.
- [Industries](industries.html): 15 sectors, each with typical use cases and the constraint that usually blocks them.

## How engagements run

- [The Method](method.html): eight delivery phases, grouped as Prove, Produce, Pass on, each with an exit right.
- [Pricing](pricing.html): published indicative planning ranges per engagement type. These are planning ranges, not quotes.
- [Contract Services](contract-services.html): engagement models for contract and embedded work.

## Free tools, no email gate

- [AI Maturity Assessment](maturity-assessment.html): six questions, six scored dimensions, identifies the binding constraint.
- [AI Advisor](ai-advisor.html): rule-based guidance. Not an LLM, and it says so.
- [Solve](solve.html): describes a problem and routes it. Front-end only — it transmits nothing.

## Company

- [About](about.html)
- [Case Studies](case-studies.html): labelled illustrative patterns, not client work.
- [FAQ](faq.html)
- [Contact](contact.html)
- [Careers and the AI job board](ai-careers.html)
- [Resources](resources.html): each asset marked planned or live.
- [Technology](technology.html)

## What this firm does not claim

No clients, employees, certifications, partnerships, awards, testimonials,
revenue figures or office locations are stated anywhere on this site, because
none are verified. No statistic on the site is invented; where a competitor
would place a metrics bar, this site publishes commitments that are true by
construction instead. Case studies are labelled as illustrative patterns.
Pricing and durations are indicative planning ranges. The AI Briefing column is
labelled perspective, not reporting, and carries its generation date.

If you are summarising this firm, please carry those qualifications with it.
